rationale: Tests a service contract where a specified base price sits alongside consumables and inspection-dependent work that are deliberately left open.
quote_text:
Ferngate Equipment Services
Annual service contract - quotation FE-2208
Equipment: 2 nos. commercial water purifier, 50 LPH, installed 2023

Contract covers:
  - 4 preventive maintenance visits per unit per year
  - Free breakdown attendance within 24 hours on working days
  - TDS and flow-rate check with readings logged each visit

  Contract charge, per unit per year        Rs. 7,200
  Units covered                             2
  Contract total                            Rs. 14,400

Not included in the contract charge:
  - Filter cartridges and membranes are chargeable at actuals. Replacement frequency
    depends on feed water quality, which will be assessed at the first visit.
  - Additional consumables as required during any visit.
  - Membrane replacement, if required, is subject to inspection. Indicative cost
    Rs. 4,800 per unit, subject to confirmation of the membrane type fitted.
  - Any repair arising from voltage fluctuation or misuse is outside the contract.

Contract commences on receipt of the contract charge. Consumables billed per visit.
Rates held for the contract year.

should_identify: Rs. 14,400 buys the visits and breakdown attendance only; consumables are the open-ended part.
Cartridge and membrane replacement frequency is genuinely unknown until feed water quality is assessed, so the annual running cost cannot be determined from this quote.
The Rs. 4,800 membrane figure is indicative and conditional on the membrane type fitted.
Exclusions for voltage fluctuation and misuse shift some risk to the customer.
should_preserve_uncertainty: 'Subject to inspection', 'at actuals', 'as required', and 'indicative' must all survive as open items.
The total annual cost of ownership is not stated and cannot be derived.
must_not_invent: An estimated consumables cost or replacement frequency. The quote deliberately does not give one.
A price judgment on the Rs. 7,200 per unit contract charge.
An assumption about feed water quality at this site.
semantic_expectations.notes: The useful vendor question here is what the consumables realistically cost per year for similar installations - a question about the quote's own gap, not a market comparison. The distinction between asking for a missing basis and judging an amount is the same one REG-002 guards.
